decisions.title: Co-founder Drama
decisions.flavor: Your co-founders disagree loudly about the roadmap. The team is watching.

decisions.title: The Shortcut
decisions.flavor: You can ship the feature today by cutting corners, or ship it right next week.

choices.label: Take the shortcut: ship faster now, pay for it later
Do it right: slower, but clean

decisions.title: An Early Feeler
decisions.flavor: A much bigger company floats a number "just to see if you'd bite." It's real, and it's a lowball.

decisions.title: The Board Seat
decisions.flavor: A prominent investor will only write the check if they get a board seat.

decisions.title: Co-founder Drama, Part Two
decisions.flavor: The product-led bet from your Scrappy days is paying off, but your growth-minded co-founder still isn't over it.

choices.label: Bring them onto the roadmap process

decisions.title: Everyone's Raising
decisions.flavor: Every founder you know is closing a bigger round than the last. It is tempting to spend like they did.

choices.label: Chase the hype, spend on growth marketing

decisions.title: The Keynote Invite
decisions.flavor: You are invited to keynote the industry's biggest conference of the year.

choices.label: Accept, put the founder on stage

decisions.title: A Serious Offer
decisions.flavor: A public company wants to buy you outright, at a real number, with real term sheets attached.

decisions.title: Talent Poaching War
decisions.flavor: A flush competitor offers your best engineer a package you can barely believe.

decisions.title: Viral Backlash
decisions.flavor: A screenshot of an old internal joke goes viral for all the wrong reasons.

choices.label: Take the high road, stay quiet

decisions.title: Second Thoughts
decisions.flavor: Remember that early acquisition offer you turned down? An investor brings it up, unprompted, at exactly the wrong moment.

choices.label: Quietly wonder if you made a mistake

decisions.title: The Vulture
decisions.flavor: A distressed-asset buyer circles, offering a lowball price and a fast, quiet close.

choices.label: Take the vulture deal, cut your losses

decisions.title: The Board Wants Cuts
decisions.flavor: The board is pushing hard for a 20% headcount reduction to stretch the runway.

choices.label: Hold the line, protect the team

decisions.title: The Comeback Story
decisions.flavor: A journalist offers to write you up as the scrappy survivor bucking the downturn.

decisions.title: The Only Term Sheet
decisions.flavor: It's 40% below your last valuation, with control provisions attached. It's also the only offer on the table.

choices.label: Refuse, ride out the runway you have
